'''CT-5/373''',<ref name="Magazine">[[Star Wars Adventures Magazine 9|''Star Wars Adventures Magazine'' 9]]</ref> also known as '''5/373''',<ref name="card" /> and '''Seven-three''',<ref name="Magazine" /> was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="db" /> [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone warrior]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. As a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]],<ref name="card" /> 5/373 was created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]]. They were cloned from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] male [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], and therefore shared traits such as standing at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="db" /> and having [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> 5/373 was deployed in<ref name="card" /> the [[Petranaki arena|execution arena]] on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]<ref name="Geonosis">{{DB|location|geonosis|Geonosis}}</ref> and participated in<ref name="card" /> the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="Geonosis" /> During the battle, 5/373 wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] and wielded a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]].<ref name="card" />

==Behind the scenes==
5/373 was first named and depicted on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20201116174457/https://swtcg.com/Content/Images/Cards/AOTC/Clone_Warrior_5_373.webp?v=2 Clone Warrior 5/373] card in the [[Star Wars Trading Card Game|''Star Wars'' Trading Card Game]] expansion [[Attack of the Clones (TCG)|Attack of the Clones]],<ref name="card" /> released on [[April 23]], [[2002]].<ref name="Release">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/aotc_trading_card_game_press_release_67446.asp|text=AOTC Trading Card Game Press Release|author=Thomas|date=2002-04-26|quote=&hellip;the TCG is scheduled to be on stores shelves on April 23.|archivedate=20160512090918}}</ref> The clone was later identified as "CT-5/373" and "Seven-three" in the article [[Ask Star Wars Adventures About...|Ask ''Star Wars Adventures'' About... The Clone Wars!]] published in the [[Star Wars Adventures Magazine 9|ninth issue]] of the [[Star Wars Adventures Magazine|''Star Wars'' Adventures Magazine]], released in [[June]] [[2003]].<ref name="Magazine" />
